rows.grounds: locative indicating ritual context of teaching
demonstrative pronoun referring to the procedure
qualifier indicating brevity of the rite
ritual initiation designated by the procedure

items.question: What ritual procedure constitutes the abbreviated initiation during instruction?
premises: Recitation should be performed in the ear.
This recitation occurs within the context of instruction.
This procedure is designated as the abbreviated initiation.
items.inference: Performing recitation in the ear during instruction constitutes the abbreviated initiation.
uncertainties: The exact number of recitations is supplied by the preceding verse and not repeated here.
items.plain_english: One should recite in the ear during instruction; this procedure is thus the abbreviated initiation.
